title: crataegus prunifolia var. ovalifolia
intro: Crataegus prunifolia var. ovalifolia, commonly known as the Chinese Hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China, belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus prunifolia var. ovalifolia include cardiotonic, vasodilatory, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as hypertension and heart failure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
